decisions.reason: As a 2023 extension of the core spraying business that is still shown in 2024, it likely remains a low-cost option to keep open despite limited evidence of broad market traction.
Its own product page in both years and evidence that it progressed from test phase into the marketed range suggest uncertainty has fallen enough to justify continuing the product.
Because it builds on proven air-motor technology and stays close to the firm's established pump portfolio, management would likely retain it as a relatively inexpensive adjacent option.
A stand-alone page in both years and its fit with the firm's move toward more digitalized and interoperable customer solutions make withdrawal unlikely in the near term.

Although it is the newest and only lightly evidenced product, its closeness to the firm's established offer means the firm would usually keep it on the market longer while demand uncertainty resolves.
